svg.title: Matrix-chain dp table: diagonals by length, and the cells dp[0][3] reads
svg.desc: Upper triangle: row 0: 0, 24000, 14000, 26000; row 1: 0, 6000, 12000; row 2: 0, 9000; row 3: 0. Left panel tints each diagonal by interval length 1 to 4. Right panel: dp[0][3] with split k = 2 reads dp[0][2] to its left and dp[3][3] below it.
svg.text: reads: left in its row, below in its column
